entities.summary: Edgar Nelson Transeau (1875–1960) was an American botanist and phycologist known for his work in plant ecology and phytogeography. He is best remembered for his influential paper, "The Prairie Peninsula" published in Ecology in 1935, which examined the eastern extension of Midwestern grasslands.
